body.p: By this Amendment, Applicant amends claims 1, 3, 10, 12, and 15, cancels claims 2, 11, and 13 without any prejudice and disclaimer of the subject matter thereof, and adds new claims 21-23. Support for the amendments can be found throughout the as-filed application, for example, in para. [0074]-[0077], [0109], and [0139]-[0161] of the specification and FIGS.4-5 of the drawings. Upon entry of this Amendment, claims 1, 3-10, 12, and 14-23 remain pending and under examination.
Applicant respectfully requests that the Office favorably reconsider and withdraw the rejections, and timely allow the pending claims for at least the reasons set forth below.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for conducting the phone interview with the undersigned Applicant's representative on October 29, 2024, to discuss the amended claims and applied references, and the Examiner agreed that the amended claims overcome the applied references and the Section 101 rejection. Applicant understands that further search and consideration may be conducted.

Applicant respectfully traverses the rejection of claims 1-20 under 35 U.S.C. § 101 as

allegedly being directed to an abstract idea without significantly more. To advance prosecution, Applicant amends independent claims 1 and 12 to further claim the invention. As agreed during the interview, Applicant respectfully submits that the amended claims are patent eligible, and requests withdrawal of the rejections to claims 1 and 12 and their respective dependent claims.

Applicant respectfully traverses the rejection of claims 1-20 under 35 U.S.C. § 102 as allegedly being anticipated by Yang. However, to expedite the prosecution of the present application, Applicant amends independent claims 1 and 12 by incorporating the subject matter recited in the now cancelled claim 2 and other limitations to further define the claimed invention.

As agreed during the interview, Applicant respectfully submits that Yang fails to teach or suggest, "performing path splicing on the first plot path and the historical plot path according to a default splicing rule to obtain a default spliced plot path, wherein the default spliced plot path is formed by a current path and a partial historical plot path, the current path starts from the root node and follows the first plot path to reach a first intersection node of the one or more intersection nodes, and the partial historical plot path starts from the first intersection node and follows the historical plot path to reach the target node; in response to that the default spliced plot path conforms to a plot logic rule and satisfies a plot parameter condition, using the default spliced plot path as a target spliced plot path; in response to that the default spliced plot path does not conform to the plot logic rule, identifying a determination node that causes the default spliced plot path to be logically unreachable, and performing path splicing on the first plot path and the historical plot path based on the determination node and a superior-subordinate

relationship between the current node and the target node, to obtain the target spliced plot path that conforms to the plot logic rule and satisfies the plot parameter condition," as recited in amended claim 1 (emphasis added), and similar features in amended independent claims 7 and 13.
Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the rejection under 35 U.S.C. § 102.

Newly added independent claim 21, although different in scope from amended claim 1, recite elements similar to those of claim 1. For at least reasons similar to those discussed above with respect to the Section 102 rejection of claim 1, claim 21 is also allowable over the cited art, as well as its dependent new claims 22-23.

In light of the above, Applicant respectfully requests Examiner's favorable consideration and timely allowance of all pending claims. If any issues may be resolved by telephone with the Applicant's representative, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the numbers shown.
Please grant any extensions of time required to enter this response and charge any additional required fees to Deposit Account 505213.
